tagline: Pet portraits from your favorite photos
one_liner: Turn pet photos into portraits worth keeping.
short_description_en: Pettenderly turns photos of your cat or dog into AI portraits. Choose a watercolor, royal or studio look, then download your image.
medium_description_en: Pettenderly is an online AI pet portrait studio. Upload one to five photos of the same pet, choose a style such as watercolor or Royal Nobility, and download the result. Each successful image uses one credit. Buy a credit pack or subscribe for a monthly allowance.
long_description_en:
Pettenderly turns everyday pet photos into downloadable AI portraits. Start with one to five clear photos of the same pet, with its eyes and coat markings visible. Choose a watercolor look, a royal costume or a sunny window-seat scene. Create a portrait in the studio, then revisit My creations to download your favorites.

Two beta tools offer more ways to use your photos. You & your pet combines separate person and pet reference photos into a portrait together. Photo cleanup lets you describe a change, such as removing a cable from the background. Faces, markings and fine details can vary in generated images.

Each successful image uses one credit; failed generations do not use credits. Buy a one-time Starter Pack or choose a Pro subscription for a monthly allowance. The result is a digital image you can download and keep.
short_description_cn: Pettenderly 是在线 AI 宠物写真工具。上传 1–5 张同一只宠物的照片，选择水彩、皇家或影棚风格，生成并下载一幅专属画像。
medium_description_cn: Pettenderly 可以把猫狗的日常照片做成可下载的 AI 写真。上传 1–5 张能看清眼睛、毛色和花纹的照片，选择水彩、皇家或窗边场景。每张成功生成的图片消耗 1 点，点数可一次性购买，也可通过 Pro 订阅按月获得。
long_description_cn:
在 Pettenderly，你可以把手机里熟悉的宠物照做成一幅写真。选 1–5 张同一只猫或狗的清晰照片，再挑一个喜欢的风格，比如水彩、皇家肖像或阳光下的窗边场景。生成后可在工作室查看结果，并在「我的作品」下载保存。

人宠合影和照片清理目前均为 Beta。前者可分别上传人物和宠物照片，生成同框画像；后者可按文字要求处理照片，例如移除背景里的一根电线。人物面部、宠物花纹和其他细节可能发生变化。

每张成功生成的图片消耗 1 点，失败不扣点。可以一次性购买 Starter 点数包，也可以订阅 Pro 获得每月额度。交付内容为可下载的数字图片。
cat_description_en: Pettenderly helps cat owners turn everyday photos into AI cat portraits. Upload one to five clear photos of the same cat, choose a watercolor, royal or window-seat style, and download a digital keepsake. Each successful image uses one credit.
cat_description_cn: Pettenderly 可以把猫咪的日常照片做成 AI 写真。上传 1–5 张同一只猫的清晰照片，挑选水彩、皇家或窗边风格，生成后下载保存。每张成功生成的图片消耗 1 点。
target_users: Cat and dog owners creating digital keepsakes
Pet lovers making a digital portrait as a gift
language_note: Six locale options are configured. Do not promise every interface or content page is fully translated.
pricing_model: Paid. One-time credit packs or a subscription.
pricing: One successful image costs 1 credit. The $4.99 Starter Pack has 12 non-expiring credits. Pro costs $9.90/month or $79/year, with 40 credits each month on either plan. Unused monthly credits do not roll over. Currency: USD.
account_access: A Starter Pack can be purchased as a guest; its email access link returns to credits and history. Pro subscriptions require an account. Image generation requires available credits. The signup_required field is false for the guest Starter Pack route, not a claim of anonymous free generation.
official_x_note: User confirmed on 2026-11-14 as Pettenderly's official brand account. Use for product X/Twitter fields only; not the user's or founder's personal account.
source_repository_note: User-provided development repository. Public listing or open-source status has not been confirmed; do not fill directory GitHub/open-source fields from this alone.

business_facts.launch_date_note: User confirmed first launch in October 2026; exact day and company founding date remain unconfirmed.
business_facts.country_note: User confirmed product country as China; this does not establish a city, address, or legal entity.

limitations: Portraits accept one to five JPG, PNG or WebP photos of the same pet, up to 8 MB each.
You & your pet and photo cleanup are beta features. Faces, markings and fine details may change.
Downloads are digital images. The listed plans do not include physical printing or delivery.
No free plan or free-generation offer is advertised. Do not guarantee a generation time, image resolution, exact likeness, or unlimited usage.

Founder, legal entity, office, public phone, company founding date, exact launch day, team size, funding and official social profiles other than the user-confirmed Pettenderly X account are unverified. User confirmed first launch month as October 2026 and country as China.
Do not claim soulpaw.art already redirects to Pettenderly; that migration is not confirmed.
